root_cause: The deploy workflow was run with break_config=true, which means the Kubernetes Secret containing REQUIRED_SECRET was deliberately not created. When FAULT=bad_config is set, the application checks for REQUIRED_SECRET at startup and raises RuntimeError if it is absent, causing the container to exit with code 1 immediately. Kubernetes enters CrashLoopBackOff because every restart hits the same missing-variable error.
contributing_factors: REQUIRED_SECRET env var absent from Kubernetes Secret / deployment
FAULT=bad_config causes app startup to validate and raise on missing var
Container exits with code 1 before serving any request
Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff: all replicas fail the same way
Liveness and readiness probes never succeed — pods never become ready
CI deploy workflow skipped secret creation (break_config=true)
evidence: Application log: 'REQUIRED_SECRET env var is not set — startup aborted'
Secret shoplite-secret missing or does not contain REQUIRED_SECRET
GitHub Actions deploy job: break_config=true in workflow inputs
Readiness probe failing: no pods ever ready

remediation.recommendation: Create the missing Kubernetes Secret with REQUIRED_SECRET and redeploy.
steps: kubectl create secret generic shoplite-secret --from-literal=REQUIRED_SECRET=<value> -n shoplite
Add secret existence validation to the deploy workflow to prevent recurrence
